pattern: に限ったことではない（にかぎったことではない）
aliases: にかぎったことではない
purpose: Deny that an issue belongs exclusively to one case.
keywords: N + に限ったことではない
Staff shortages are not confined to rural areas.
It is not only newcomers who get nervous.
This concern is not unique to me.
formation: N + に限ったことではない
restrictions: Usually broadens a problem or tendency to other groups.
mistake: It does not deny that the named case has the issue.
